messages:
Jamie: Heads up — EquinoxBank POC tomorrow. They need SAML + SCIM + RBAC. Two blockers: subdomain verification and group->role mapping. Need to confirm before IdP call. @Priya @Maya

Priya: Need Azure AD metadata file and list of groups. SCIM: can we support nested groups? We flatten to direct group membership by default (we can script expansion if they provide nesting).

Alex: SP ACS for POC: https://poc-equinox.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs. I'll add SP metadata to the shared POC doc for them to import into Azure AD.

Maya (Security): SCIM must be TLS only; recommend token rotation and rotation cadence. Use exact-match group allowlist to avoid role escalation (example: 'equinox-admins' -> 'admin').

Sam (Solutions): POC traffic policy: we typically exclude small evals (<50k tokens/day) from committed usage. Offer: 2-week trial at 100k tokens/day cap, or short reserved term. I'll draft the wording for commercial.

Jamie: Can we scope roles to routes/models? Their infra wants finance-team -> embeddings only.

Alex: Yes. We support per-route policies. For POC we can create a role that allows routes matching 'embedding.*' and denies 'generate.*'. Need canonical route names from their app.

Priya: Action items for EquinoxBank: 1) Azure AD SAML metadata file, 2) SCIM base URL + bearer token, 3) CSV of groups to map, 4) DNS TXT entries for both domains (root + subdomain). I'll collect and schedule the IdP admin call after we get metadata.

Maya (Security): Also ask them to complete the short security questionnaire: cert rotation policy, token HSM usage, SCIM token rotation TTL. I'll attach the checklist link on the call.

Jamie: Please add the SP metadata and SCIM sample to the POC doc so I can send to their IdP admin. :thumbsup:
